messages.subject: problem with secr
parts:
Good evening
While I am running CL=T (conditional likelihood ) in basic Null model,
I am facing problem Kindly see

CH <- read.capthist("capture.txt", "trap.txt", detector = "proximity", cov = "sex")
No errors found :-)
mask <- read.mask ("mask.txt")
fit0CL<- secr.fit(CH,mask=mask,CL=T)
Checking data 
Error in valid.pnames(details, model, CL, detectfn, alltelem, q, nonID) : 
  parameters in model not consistent with detectfn etc. : D

 as I am planing to do more covariate & gender specific models using CL=T. So for selecting best model over Null model I am using CL=T for Null model too.
Please advice What else is missing in code.

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: problem with secr
parts:
[I seem to have sent only a personal reply before - now posting also to list]

This is a significant bug in the software, introduced in the recent version. An internal check on the model argument fails with CL = TRUE when no model is specified (i.e. the default is used). It seems you can get around it by providing a null model argument:

fit0CL<- secr.fit(CH,mask=mask,CL=T, model = g0~1)

Thanks for reporting this. I'll fix it ASAP.
Murray
